notes: Tax obligation per item: item of the group (active, group allowed for the user group), percentage from ST_ITEM.VAT_VALUE, percentage > 0, range button by item group (تطبيق) - APP_RULES3_TX, see processes/TX_ITEMS.md

TX_TAXES_ITEMS.PRICE_AFTER.sql: (select max((u.retail_sale_price * (100 + t.tax_per)) / 100) from st_item_unit u where u.item_code = t.item_code and u.group_code = t.group_code and u.basic_unit = 1)

params.name: TAX
params.lov_sql: select tax_code || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(name_e, name_a) else name_a end d, tax_code r from tx_taxes_types order by tax_code

params.name: FROM_GRP
params.lov_sql: select item_group_code || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(name_e, name_a) else name_a end d, item_group_code r from st_item_group where nvl(stop_flag, 0) = 0 and group_status = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or item_group_code in (select group_code from st_group_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by item_group_code

params.name: TO_GRP
params.lov_sql: select item_group_code || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(name_e, name_a) else name_a end d, item_group_code r from st_item_group where nvl(stop_flag, 0) = 0 and group_status = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or item_group_code in (select group_code from st_group_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by item_group_code
